summary: One icon-cache block: a 0x70-byte on-disk block header at +0 (0x6060 tag, record id, entry table), a 0xC-stride entry table at +0x70, and two 0x20-byte page descriptors at +0x1FC and +0x3AC that own the 0x70-byte entry pages read through the storage vtable.
evidence: Ui_IconCache_ResetHeader memsets the first 0x70 bytes and restores the 0x6060 tag; Ui_IconCache_WriteRawBlock validates 0x6060 and the 0x70..0x19000 size range and copies the block header into self; maybe_Ui_IconCache_ReadPageEntries reads a 0x20-byte page header at +0x1FC/+0x3AC and walks 0x70-byte entries tagged 0x6060; Ui_IconCache_Open stores the record id at +0x04. The batch's std_String base is the cache-name member at +0x20, not a base class. BASE CLEARED (S_120 resume): the batch's std_String base is the 24-byte cache-name member at +0x20, not inherited storage.

summary: Casino slot-machine jackpot presentation screen (step table 0x0072AA0C, reel widget at +0x11C, payout counter at +0xE4) plus the 2D animation object it creates (vtable 0x007601A8, default animation block at +0x220..+0x2E8).
evidence: Ui_JackpotScreen_Ctor installs vtable 0x00760260, allocates a separate 0x382C-byte Ui_RouletteWindow and stores it at +0x44, and initialises +0x0C..+0x24; maybe_Ui_JackpotScreen_CreateAnimObject installs vtable 0x007601A8 (the batch's 26-slot table) and fills +0x220..+0x2E8. CAVEAT: the batch's base Ui_RouletteWindow is 13108 bytes, larger than this class's 3560, so the base is a member, not a base; the class also merges the animation object with the screen. BASE CLEARED (S_120 resume): Ui_RouletteWindow is 13108 bytes, larger than this 3560-byte object, so it is a separately allocated member at +0x44, not a base class.
